description: This file provides utility functions for file system operations such as writing a file only if contents have changed, removing a specific file, and removing a directory or path with safety checks.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes contents to a file only if the contents differ from the current file content, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes a specified file if it exists, using force removal.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or path recursively if it exists.
